pages.title: Beast Heart
pages.text: The core used to summon a $(l:raidborn:mobs/beast)Beast$(/l). Place a Carved Pumpkin above it, Mud below it and on two opposite sides, and a Chest directly against either remaining horizontal side.$(br2)The Beast faces away from the Chest.

pages.title: Obtaining
pages.text: The Beast Heart is made with the $(l:raidborn:mechanics/transmutation_table)Transmutation Table$(/l). Its exact recipe is listed in the table's entry.
